target.statement: Spearman correlation between stability delta and Kralj Novak sentiment variance is ρ = +0.361 (Holm p = 0.015, n = 59 emojis)
target.table_ref: Table 2, row 'Δ vs. Kralj Novak variance (primary)'
target.dataset: Emoji Sarcasm Dataset (ESD) Twitter partition + Kralj Novak 2015 emoji sentiment lexicon

compute.basis: Paper states all experiments run on CPU and regenerating every number takes ~3 minutes; the target only needs MiniLM embeddings of ~16.5k short tweets plus a Spearman correlation over 59 emojis, so install/download dominates.

blockers: Code is only in an anonymous.4open.science repository (not a stable GitHub link); may be unavailable or incomplete
ESD is released for non-commercial research use only and may require manual download/acceptance
Kralj Novak lexicon accessed via emosent-py package; exact version/matching not pinned
title: Beyond a Single Sentiment Score: Topical and Affective Dimensions of Emoji Meaning on Twitter
